text:
Type: compact one-door storage cabinet
Use: storing media, books and everyday items behind a door; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: white laminated board body, high-gloss lacquered door, small plastic feet
Colors: glossy warm grey-beige, white
Shape: simple boxy cube with one full flush handleless door, crisp square edges, tiny feet, sleek reflective front, compact, light visual weight
Feel: sleek, soft, calm, tidy
Goes with: white walls, light or dark wood, taupe and grey textiles; modern or minimalist living rooms and home offices

product.name: BEST
product.description: May be completed with knobs or handles. Sold separately. Drill template for marking of hole positions for handles or knobs is sold separately. View more product information A simple unit can be enough storage for a limited space or the foundation for a larger storage solution if your needs change.
